VoltDot 20 – 20000mAh Mini Power Bank with Fast Charging

VoltDot 20 mini power bank is your ultimate travel companion — a compact yet powerful 20000mAh  designed to keep your devices charged anywhere. Its stylish pinstripe design and round digital display area blend fashion with functionality, making it a perfect match for modern tech users.

Key Features of VoltDot 20 Power Bank

  • Massive 20,000mAh Battery: Ensures long-lasting backup for smartphones, tablets, and wearables.
  • Compact & Lightweight: Mini power bank that fits easily in your pocket or travel bag.
  • 22.5W Fast Charging: Delivers efficient charging speed with Qualcomm 3.0 and PD (Power Delivery) support.
  • Multiple Output Ports: Comes with 2 USB-A and 1 USB-C output for simultaneous charging.
  • Smart Digital Display: Circular LED display shows real-time battery status.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Android, iPhone, tablets, cameras, and other USB-powered devices.

Why Choose VoltDot 20 Mini Power Bank?

Engineered with advanced fast-charging technology, VoltDot 20 ensures optimal power delivery without overheating. Whether you’re commuting, traveling, or working remotely, this portable power bank guarantees convenience and efficiency in one compact device. It’s the ideal choice for users who need reliable mobile charging solutions without compromising style.

Specifications:

  • Battery Capacity: 20,000mAh
  • Output Ports: 2 × USB-A, 1 × USB-C
  • Charging Output: 22.5W Fast Charge
  • Technology: Qualcomm 3.0 + PD Charging
  • Design: Pinstripe with Round Display
